guide.title: How XP works
guide.correct: Each correct answer in a checked mode (Multiple choice, Write, Dictation, Cloze, Match, Speak, Test, Word rain): +{{xp}} XP.
guide.due: If that card was due for review: +{{xp}} XP more.
guide.combo: Every {{size}} correct answers in a row: +{{xp}} XP bonus (a wrong answer restarts the count).
guide.repeat: Answering the same card correctly again within {{minutes}} minutes earns nothing extra.
guide.selfGraded: Flashcards are self-rated, so each "I know it" earns only +{{xp}} XP with no bonuses. Flipping and tapping right away (under {{seconds}} seconds) earns nothing.
guide.cap: Up to {{xp}} XP per day. You can keep studying after that and your card progress is still saved.
guide.example: Example: 5 correct in a row, 2 of them due = 5 × {{correct}} + 2 × {{due}} + {{combo}} = {{total}} XP.
guide.level: Level 1 to 2 takes {{first}} XP, and each level after needs {{step}} XP more than the one before (level 2 to 3 takes {{second}} XP, 3 to 4 takes {{third}} XP...). XP is never taken away.
guide.goal: Your goal is the XP you aim for each study day (from midnight). It does not change how XP is earned; it just helps you keep a steady pace.

wordRain.title: Word Rain
wordRain.intro: Meanings fall on enemy drones. Answer with the English word so your jet shoots them down before they land.
wordRain.styleTypeHint: Type the word on your keyboard
wordRain.speakUnsupported: This browser can't recognise speech. Try Chrome or Edge.
wordRain.ruleType: Type the first letter to lock the lowest matching target; each correct letter fires. Only letters are needed; spaces and punctuation fill in. Backspace releases the lock.
wordRain.ruleSpeak: Say the word for any target; the jet hits the lowest one with that word.
wordRain.ruleShields: You have 3 shields; each landing target costs one. Every third wave brings a big target that needs two answers.
wordRain.ruleCombo: Keep a streak to multiply points ×2, ×3, ×4.
wordRain.rulePause: Press Esc or the pause button to rest; leaving the tab pauses too.
wordRain.tooFew: Word Rain needs at least {{count}} cards.
wordRain.imeHint: A Vietnamese input method may swallow w, s, f, r, x, j. The in-game keyboard types exactly what you press.
wordRain.typeHint: Type here; letters fire as you type
